ref_file_title: KLS18 - A Concrete Treatment of Fiat-Shamir Signatures in the Quantum Random-Oracle Model
authors: Eike Kiltz, Vadim Lyubashevsky, Christian Schaffner
note: cryptobib_key: EC:KilLyuSch18 (verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib, pp. 552-586). eprint 2017/916. QROM treatment of Fiat-Shamir signatures: Dilithium-QROM (a larger-parameter variant with a lossy identification scheme) is tightly secure in the QROM under MLWE; the original Dilithium is QROM-secure under MLWE, MSIS and the new SelfTargetMSIS assumption.

ref_file_title: KOS16 - MASCOT Faster Malicious Arithmetic Secure Computation with Oblivious Transfer
authors: Marcel Keller, Emmanuela Orsini, Peter Scholl
note: cryptobib CCS:KelOrsSch16 (pages 830-842, doi 10.1145/2976749.2978357) and EPRINT:KelOrsSch16 (eprint 2016/505); dblp record conf/ccs/KellerOS16 and the CCS'16 abstract confirmed via search snippets. MASCOT instantiates the SPDZ preprocessing (authenticated multiplication triples over a finite field) from OT extension instead of somewhat-homomorphic encryption.
